Lua 5.4.9

Official source: https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz
SHA-256: 2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6
Verified against https://www.lua.org/ftp/ on October 11, 2026.

This directory contains the Lua core and the auxiliary, base, math,
string, table, and UTF-8 source libraries. Standalone executables and the OS, IO,
package loader, coroutine and debug libraries are omitted. No prebuilt binary
or download step is required to build the project. Lua headers retain upstream
copyright notices; the full license follows.

Local integration patch: lprefix.h disables MSVC warning C4702 (unreachable code)
for Lua C translation units, because upstream includes defensive returns after
non-returning errors and Unreal treats that warning as an error. The prefix is
not used by the public API headers. No Lua behavior or other warning is changed.
